GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, slow into stride and Settled Down last of eight runners, trailed 5.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Ground to the winner while racing tightly in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # slow early

Jumped awkwardly, beaten for speed & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, railed up to 1.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn , inside run presented on straightening, railed to Lead 150m, Headed 50m from post. [Stewards: Over-raced early/middle stages proving difficult to restrain. Warning placed on its racing manners.] # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Over raced in the early and middles stages, proving difficult to restrain. Held up for clear running round home turn. Warning on racing manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, little change to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start, shifted in and bumped. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back in second half 3 Wide 6 Lengths 500m, pushed widest from the corner, battled on well in Straight and was not far away from first group # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Raced keenly and inclined to lay out early. Raced wide throughout. Hung out from the 600m until the entrance of the home straight. Warning for its racing manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well Wide out pushing on settled close up Outside Leader (700m), wobbled cornering Quickly Beaten off faded to the line # pace/weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out approaching and round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down /2 Lengths Clear of winner, Headed Turning for home remained in 2nd until the 100m then Couldn'T Go On had its chance - # led the winner
Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 1 length settling down, Held Together in front & led Two Wide by 1.75 Lengths turning, Headed 220m and Lost Ground in Straight # weak once headed
Jumped awkwardly missing start a bit & Settled Down 4 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , made no ground to Turn but moved from 8th to 6th place, lost a length in Straight # wide, had cover
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Raced wide with cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, slow into stride & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, improved marginally to 2.5 Lengths rail turning, kept coming and emerged from the pack to take 2nd place # battled on ok

Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, kept battling in and only Headed at the 100m. Better effort than 150/1 might have expected. (Bubble Cheeker (Near Side) OFF AGAIN, Cheekers FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit FIRST TIME, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # battled on fairly
Jumped ok settled down just off speed 2-3 Lengths (500m), plenty of room to come Through Straight however leader off & gone, this held Ground # did have chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount was inclined to lay out over the concluding stages and affected being able to ride the horse out.
